company.name: Blitzllama
company.shortDescription: Blitzllama is an in-product user research platform for product development teams.
company.description: Blitzllama makes customer feedback accessible to product and research teams. Using Blitzllama, teams can run in-product surveys, conduct usability tests, and capture customer requests across tools in a single place. This enables teams to identify and solve customer problems better and hit business objectives more often.

productsAndServices.description: A platform feature to run targeted surveys within web or mobile products to collect real-time user feedback.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-driven system that automatically categorizes, summarizes, and generates actionable insights from user feedback data.

productsAndServices.description: A tool to conduct unmoderated user testing on design prototypes before development to identify usability issues and validate concepts.
productsAndServices.name: Prototype Tests

productsAndServices.description: Surveys distributed via shareable links to collect feedback across multiple channels with personalization and multi-language support.
productsAndServices.name: Link Surveys

productsAndServices.description: A system to unify and synchronize customer feedback from multiple sources into a single platform for analysis.
productsAndServices.name: Feedback Data Integration and Management
